evaluation_protocol.test_set_status: Reused historical benchmark (NB09 baseline reuse; NOT a fresh untouched test set)
evaluation_protocol.description: The 2023 test set was previously held out and evaluated in NB09, and was reused here strictly as a historical benchmark for comparative evaluation. It was consulted exactly once as a confirmatory check; no hyperparameter tuning or ensemble weight optimization was performed against it. All candidate model selection and blending weights were determined strictly using the 2022 validation split. Continued iterative tuning or model selection against this 2023 partition is strictly prohibited.

sample_reconciliation.description: NB09 evaluated models on a matched dual-sensor intersection where both S1 and S2 observed the same lake in 2023 (N=1,742 matched lake-year observations). NB11 initially evaluated standalone per-sensor candidate models on all available single-sensor observations for that sensor (S1 N=2,055; S2 N=2,507). Reconciled metrics on the identical matched cohort (N=1,742 matched lake-year observations) are provided in reports/11_reconciled_matched_test_metrics.csv. Unmatched observations (313 S1-only and 765 S2-only observations) reflect differences in sensor inventory inclusion, acquisition geometry, spatial coverage, and observation filtering. They are described neutrally rather than attributing all mismatches to cloud cover or radar gaps without record-level provenance.

11_best_s1_pkl.status: Candidate S1-only model pending additional validation (NOT an approved replacement for Fused XGBoost)

paired_bootstrap_test_vs_xgboost.statistical_significance: NOT statistically significant at alpha=0.05 (95% CI includes zero: [-0.001184, +0.000021] km² / [-1183.5, +20.7] m²)
paired_bootstrap_test_vs_xgboost.interpretation: Random Forest demonstrates empirical improvement over XGBoost on S1 (observed delta MAE = -0.000529 km² = -529 m², not -0.529 m²), but because the 95% bootstrap confidence interval includes zero [-0.001184, +0.000021] km², the difference is not statistically conclusive. 11_best_s1.pkl is retained strictly as a candidate S1-only model pending additional validation, not an approved replacement for the fused model.

s2_benchmark_status.rationale: Persistence outperforms all single-sensor optical ML models on both validation and test sets; all trained single-sensor S2 models exhibit negative test R² on single-sensor GLO features. The S2 persistence baseline is retained as the benchmark unless further independent evidence supports another model.

production_model.status: Best observed candidate on the matched cohort (N=1,742 matched lake-year observations); preserved validated production baseline.
